title: Return campaign overlay lore from world_query
description:
Update world_query so campaign overlay lore is returned alongside module canon.

The DM needs to be able to retrieve improvised lore after it has been promoted. Query results should make the source/tier clear so the model and auditor know whether a result came from module canon, campaign state, overlay lore, or recent scene context.

Acceptance criteria:
- world_query can return campaign overlay lore records relevant to the query.
- Query results include canon tier/source metadata.
- Module canon and overlay lore are not conflated.
- Overlay lore can be queried by:
  - location
  - NPC
  - subject
  - tags/kind
  - recent/current scene relevance where appropriate
- If module canon and overlay lore conflict, results expose that conflict rather than silently choosing one.
- Tests cover retrieving:
  - Old Renn missing-cart style hook
  - north-gate evidence style clue
  - local rumor/belief
  - decorative color not present because it was never promoted
close_reason: Implemented campaign overlay canon, truth-statused lore recording, world_query retrieval/search, audit/prompt guidance, docs, and regression coverage.
